Measurement and verification (M&V) determines whether performance changed relative to an agreed baseline. Specify what is inside the measurement boundary, which readings will be collected, and how independent drivers will be handled. Routine adjustments account for normal effects such as weather; non-routine adjustments address unusual site changes. A retrofit coinciding with another operational change requires separate treatment before savings are credited.
